section.title: DFX support
section.intro: Release this workgroup to DFX support so that it can help you. Without a release support has no access.
section.write: Released to support: read and write (since {since}).
section.write.now: Released to support: read and write.
section.people.none: There is no support person at the moment.
section.archived: An archived workgroup cannot be released.
dialog.grant.title: Release this workgroup to DFX support?
dialog.change.title: Change the release?
dialog.revoke.title: Revoke the release?
dialog.sees: Support sees every task, conversation and the whiteboard of this workgroup – earlier ones too – and technical identifiers of the members; with write access support can write in existing tasks.
dialog.kept: What support has read stays read – also after a revocation.
dialog.devices: Tasks on DFX devices are processed there in clear independently of this release.
dialog.again: Releasing again after a revocation hands over the whole history again.
dialog.revoke.body: Support loses access at once. The workgroup gets a new key: support cannot read what is written afterwards.
